collection.description: A dying villager once offered their body to help future patients, and a healer proposes studying its organs after death.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A dying villager once offered their body to help future patients, and a healer proposes studying its organs after death.

choices.label: Ask the family to decide when no wish is known.
Preserve the body for burial without examination.

text_only.reason: the villager has already died: the premise; nobody dies now

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The family grieves but takes comfort in the villager's chosen gift.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The healer learns something useful yet cannot answer the family's deepest questions.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The family declines, and the healer respects their decision.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The family agrees to a limited examination and later requests a memorial.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The funeral proceeds according to custom, and the healer accepts the limits of knowledge.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: An apprentice begins collecting observations from living patients instead.
